head.text: PROPOSED (changes.md CS2): Data-register read, fast window (PIO mode 2), 5-clock cycle

signal.name: state
signal.data: S0 S1 S2 Sw Sw Sw Sw S3 S4 S5 S0 S1

foot.text: Proposed. Drawn at 16 MHz (1 slot = 15.6 ns). A11 = 1 selects the fast timing: /IOR (nCPU_RD) is low from edge 1 to edge 4 (187 ns), DEVMAP acknowledges at T2, and the cycle takes 5 clocks (312 ns). That meets PIO mode 2 for 16-bit transfers at 12 and 16 MHz. Use the fast window for the Data register only: the 8-bit registers need the base window's 290 ns strobes. A fast write has /IOW from edge 1 to edge 3.
